about.philosophyText: Continuously offer high-quality products at low prices, truly achieving excellent quality and affordability.
about.drivingIndustryDesc: Since 2008, Seric has delivered precision hydraulic components for machinery worldwide. As a fully integrated designer, producer, and supplier, we turn engineering challenges into reliable performance.
about.coreProductsDesc: Solenoid valves, vane pumps, gear pumps, motors, cylinders, and power units.
about.criticalIndustriesDesc: Mining, construction, agriculture, marine equipment, industrial machinery, and specialized vehicles.
about.qualitySurvivalDesc: We exist by making high-quality products – never compromised.
about.globalReachDesc: Trusted partners across 20+ sectors, especially in Southeast Asia.
about.letsWorkTogetherDesc: Partner with Seric for hydraulic solutions that boost efficiency and durability. Contact us to optimize your operations.
